options.label: Route as shipped

options.tagline: The routing this shipment actually ran
options.evidence: Recorded on tab 2020-2022 of the workbook.

options.label: Different gateway
options.evidence: Leaving through Chennai instead of Nhava Sheva changes both the inland run and the sailing: the 702 km rail leg goes away, saving 175 kg; ocean goes from 6,384 km to 5,002 km, saving 290 kg. Most of the difference is the ocean leg at 0.0084 kg CO₂e per tonne-km on 25.0 t. The workbook already sails Chennai → Laem Chabang 7 times and runs that inland chain on 7 shipments, so both halves of this route are ones it has already used.

options.label: Different inland route
options.tagline: Same gateway and sailing, a different run to the port
options.evidence: Same gateway, same sailing — only the run to Nhava Sheva changes. The road leg goes from 645 km to 21 km, saving 370 kg at 0.5928 kg CO₂e per km whatever the load. The rail leg (702 km) is unchanged. The workbook runs this shorter chain on 62 shipments (FY21-22, FY22-23), so it is a route the business has already used, not a proposal.
